source_candidate.display_name: episodic reflective strategy memory with machine-enforceable diversity and constraint actuator

audit_target.primary_study: Does Verbal Self-Reflection Transfer to Long-Horizon Scientific Discovery?

published_claim_check.design: The paper reports two Qwen model scales, 30 chemical systems per condition/model, 8 episodes per system, oracle budget B=40, locally hosted vLLM, and BASE versus REFLEXION with other hyperparameters/tools/prompts held fixed.
published_claim_check.scope: These are paper-reported aggregates plus arithmetic consistency checks, not an independent rerun of the 960 episodes.

official_artifact_findings.finding: The public MADE repository is a strong benchmark substrate: install/config structure, agent/environment/oracle code, uv.lock, baseline scripts and result schema are public.
official_artifact_findings.evidence: diffractivelabs/MADE main; README describes reproducible baseline commands and result directories; repository includes uv.lock.

official_artifact_findings.finding: The paper appendix states that its reflector DSPy signature is reproduced verbatim from made/agents/llm_react_orchestrator.py, but the current public main file src/made/agents/llm_react_orchestrator.py@d1d83cef044b704b1613cdbb7987aed655a6fcb0 contains the ReAct orchestrator and checkpoint state but no episodic reflector signature, reflection-memory buffer, or cross-episode reflection injection in the full inspected file.
official_artifact_findings.scope: This demonstrates that the currently inspected public main does not itself reproduce the paper-specific treatment implementation. It does not prove the code never existed on another branch, private artifact, or unretrieved attachment.

official_artifact_findings.finding: The public MADE root has no bundled results/ directory at the inspected main, while the README documents where locally generated results would be written.
official_artifact_findings.scope: No public raw 960-episode result bundle was located in the official benchmark main.

official_artifact_findings.finding: The paper appendix publishes the reflector prompt and a worked actor-noncompliance example, which materially improves mechanism transparency despite the missing public treatment code/results bundle.

reproduction_gaps: No exact public paper-specific reflection implementation was located in the current official MADE main despite the appendix path attribution.
No raw per-system/per-episode BASE and REFLEXION trajectories, generated result bundle, or protocol-matched independent rerun was located in this pass.
The paper does not state a random seed or decoding temperature in the inspected PDF text; exact stochastic replay therefore remains underspecified even if the treatment code is reconstructed.
The exact 30-system manifest was not located in the paper text inspected here, so matched system selection cannot be mechanically reconstructed from the paper alone.
Wilcoxon p<1e-4 and positive-slope counts 24/30 and 25/30 cannot be independently recalculated without row-level outcomes.

scope_corrections.claim: episodic reflection improves discovery yield in the tested MADE regime
scope_corrections.assessment: Supported as a matched primary-study result, not independently replicated here. Keep scope to two Qwen variants, the selected 30 ternary/quaternary/quinary systems, B=40 and 8 episodes.

scope_corrections.claim: reflection creates breadth collapse and actor non-compliance
scope_corrections.assessment: Directly reported in the primary study; the appendix provides a concrete observable non-compliance trace. The predicted failure on sparser spaces was explicitly not tested.

scope_corrections.claim: compile reflective diversity/query-cap constraints into machine-enforceable controller state
scope_corrections.assessment: Untested extension. The paper itself explicitly argues that repeatedly ignored query caps/element-coverage constraints are better moved from prompt text into the environment or tool schema, but it does not implement or evaluate that actuator. Treat this as a source-motivated mechanism hypothesis, not demonstrated improvement.

scope_corrections.claim: an enforceable actuator will preserve breadth without losing the reflection yield gain
scope_corrections.assessment: Unknown. It could also block productive exploitation and reduce yield. Requires a matched intervention arm.

independent_replication_search.result: Search results surfaced the primary paper and the public MADE benchmark, but no protocol-matched external rerun of the reported 30-system/8-episode experiment. Absence of a located rerun is not proof none exists.

high_value_next_test.design: Four-arm matched experiment on the same MADE systems/models/budget: BASE; verbal REFLEXION; REFLEXION plus hard per-composition query-cap/mandatory coverage actuator compiled from reflection; hard actuator with the same cap/coverage policy but no reflection.
high_value_next_test.reason: This separates memory benefit from enforcement benefit and tests whether the actuator repairs non-compliance without destroying productive exploitation.
